biochemEntry.title: Production entry · new batch
biochemEntry.subtitle: One batch from weighing to release · each step is checked by the database ·
biochemEntry.licenceNote: Licensed products (for example cosmetics) are made under the licence named on their process family. Without a valid licence, a batch can't be planned and no production step can be entered; Admin records licences on Admin → Licences.
biochemEntry.noCreate: You can see batches but not enter production. Ask Admin for the production right.

list.title: Open batches
list.emptyBody: Plan a batch above. It needs an approved formula in force and, for licensed products, a valid licence.

plan.title: 1 · Plan a batch
plan.formulaInForce: Formula in force: {{code}} v{{v}} for {{size}} kg
plan.noFormula: No approved formula in force for this product — planning will be refused.
plan.fgHelp: Packs land here on hold until QC releases them.
plan.numberOnSave: The batch number is given on save.
plan.hint: Choose the product, the three places and the bulk to make in kg.

reserve.title: Reserve materials
reserve.body: Reserves the bulk materials of the formula, scaled to the bulk planned, from released stock at the stores.

weigh.title: Weigh materials · second-person check
weigh.body: Weigh each material on a calibrated scale. Nothing leaves the stores until a second person checks the weight; the one who weighed can't check it.
weigh.hint: Enter the weight in kg (up to 3 decimals) for at least one material.
weigh.recorded: {{n}} weighing(s) recorded. A second person checks each one.
weigh.verified: Checked. Material issued from the stores. Batch: {{status}}.

start.title: Start making
start.body: Opens once every material is weighed and checked.

sample.title: Samples to the lab
sample.body: Send the bulk sample with the bulk weight made; after packing, send the finished-lot sample. Results are recorded on Biochem labs or the lab panel.

issue.title: Packaging to the line
issue.body: Issue packaging from the stores to the line in whole Nos. What is not used is counted back at packing.
issue.noLines: The formula has no packaging lines.
issue.hint: Enter whole numbers for at least one item.
issue.done: {{n}} packaging item(s) issued to the line.

pack.title: Fill and pack
pack.body: Record good and rejected packs once. Good packs go on hold (quarantine) as a lot numbered with the batch until QC releases them.
pack.doneMismatch: Packed into quarantine. Reconciliation does not balance — recount below.

recon.title: Reconciliation
recon.body: Packaging issued = in good packs + in rejected packs + scrapped + returned + at the line. Bulk made = packs × fill + scrapped + left, within the loss tolerance (unset = exact).
recon.bulkLine: Bulk: {{bulk}} kg made · {{scrap}} kg scrapped · {{left}} kg left · fill {{fill}} g per pack.
recon.recount: Recount (scrapped and returned only go up)
recon.mismatch: Does not reconcile. A Bug fixer item is open and the batch can't close.
recon.bulkResult: Bulk {{bulk}} kg = packed {{packed}} + scrap {{scrap}} + left {{left}} · difference {{diff}} kg · {{tol}}

qc.title: QC release
qc.body: Needs a passed bulk test and a passed finished-lot test. Anyone who planned, weighed, checked, started, issued packaging, packed or had a making duty on the batch can't release it.
qc.youMade: You helped make this batch, so the server will refuse your release; another QC person must decide.
qc.noRight: Waiting for a QC person with the release right.

close.title: Close and cost
close.body: Closing needs a balanced reconciliation; it frees what is left reserved and fixes the batch cost sheet.
close.effect: Closes the batch, frees leftover reservations and fixes its cost sheet from the consumption ledger and the cost rates in force. This can't be undone.
close.noRight: Waiting for someone with the production approve right.

label.title: Label for this batch
label.noLicence: No licence needed for this family

posts.title: What posts
posts.bulk: Bulk materials leave the stores at lot rates when each weight is checked.
posts.packaging: Packaging leaves the line as it is used in packs or scrapped; returns go back to the stores.
posts.fg: Good packs enter quarantine at material + packaging cost; QC release makes them sellable.
posts.cost: Labour, machine and overhead are added on the batch cost sheet at close.

labRef.title: Lab results
labRef.body: Results are entered by the testing lab against the formula's QC limits; a pass outside the limits is refused.
